reprintAudit.source: https://www.onepiece-cardgame.com/news/ and per-set official product pages
reprintAudit.rule: A lottery sale only counts as extra supply if its entry period falls AFTER the Japanese release date. Bandai runs Premium Bandai lotteries for the initial print run too (OP-17: entries 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-07~18, release 2026-08-22), and those are advance allocation, not a restock.
